nodes.label: Dual-Channel Connection Authentication (Key Pair vs OAuth Bearer)
nodes.norm_label: dual-channel connection authentication (key pair vs oauth bearer)
nodes.rationale: Secrets ride on MCP connection HTTP headers (x-user-key + x-api-key OR Authorization: Bearer) instead of tool arguments so credentials never enter LLM transcripts or logs; mixing channels is rejected with 422.

nodes.label: Money-Moving Confirmation Gate & Safety Rules
nodes.rationale: Prevents unintended, batched, or stale financial mutations by requiring explicit user approval of a live-validated confirmation block (or exact request) and restricting execution to one order per approval using ~2-minute connection-bound tokens.

nodes.label: x-request-id Idempotency Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Generates a fresh GUID per execute call and reuses xRequestId only when retrying the exact same timed-out or 5xx order operation to prevent double execution.

nodes.label: eToro Auth Status Alert Banner (#etoroAuthAlertBanner)
